summary: emit detects nondeterminism in the authoring program itself, not only in the engine's render, and refuses loudly
acceptance: a program interpolating Date.now() refuses at emit with DriftError::Nondeterministic; a deterministic program emits as today
tests: a program interpolating the current time refuses at emit as nondeterministic
